title: Create : radiologistics
description: Unleash wireless connectivity and node-based logic programming in your Create contraptions
body:
![Mod title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c2e7c7c0b7be3fd8bf444262e1df4bd02348955b.png)

## Unleash wireless connectivity and node-based programming ## Create: Radiologistics bridges mechanical engineering with wireless communication and logical computation, allowing you to control factories, railways, defense systems, and flying machines remotely.  

Key Features

  • Main Computer: The central processing unit of your network. Right-click to open a visual, node-based programming editor. Create math, logic, variables, and text algorithms easily.
  • Radio Transmitter & Antennas: Broadcast wireless data over massive distances. Antennas stack vertically; each segment increases the transmission range, up to a hard cap of 3,000 blocks!
  • Redstone Link Module: Seamlessly interface vanilla Create Redstone Links with your computer's algorithm. Send and receive wireless redstone signals on custom item frequencies directly within your code.
  • Memory Module: Persistently save and retrieve database variables to store state across network resets.
  • Gyroscope Sensor: Instantly measure pitch, yaw, and absolute world-space coordinates.
  • Jammer Module: Dynamically block wireless radio channels and all nearby Create Redstone Links within a 150-block radius.
  • Audio Module: Play remote URL streams (WAV, MP3, and YouTube audio) or local Text-to-Speech (TTS) announcements. Features 3D Spatial Panning — sound direction updates in real-time as you move and turn!
  • Pilot helmet: Allow to show elements/camera view on player screen, and send player pitch/yaw to computer
  • Transparent screen: similar to helmet but like a block

Integrations

  • Create Big Cannons: Adds the Wired Inertia Fuze. When a cannon shell block containing this fuze is powered by redstone, it is instantly activated and launched forward as a projectile rather than detonating on the spot. Great for remote-controlled launcher rigs!
  • Create Radars: Extract and track radar coordinates using the Network Controller directly within your algorithms.
  • Create Aeronautics: Built-in coordinate projection for moving sub-level physics grids.
  ## Requirements
  • NeoForge (1.21.1)
  • Create Mod (Mandatory)
  • Create Big Cannons, Create Radars, Create Aeronautics (Optional)
